title: `policy` row rules (`allow [write] on X as x where …`), policy functions called on a row and on an `X id`, per-role `when` and `own` — composed onto the tenant default (D-SHARING)

authzGate.//: Row rules / `when` / `own` (D-SHARING).  The ladder refuses a foreign tenant on Category's and Note's by-id read, update and destroy.  Products and shares carry a `Category id` foreign key, so a seed needs a second aggregate's row; the fixture's own `test e2e` refuses them (a foreign org reads, updates and loses its shares as 404s).

authzLadder.//: Row rules, `when` and `own` (D-SHARING) compose onto the tenant floor in the floor's own slot, so a foreign tenant with no share must still be refused on every read and write seam of a composed aggregate.  The shares, the role split and `own` are the fixture's own `test e2e` — they need principals this ladder does not have.
